title: Computing Igusa's local zeta function of univariates in deterministic polynomial-time
relevant_concepts: closed form for the number of roots mod p^k
notes: Verified from arXiv:2006.08926 / OBS 4 (2020). Delta := v_p(D(rad(f))); k0 := d(Delta+1)+1 <= d(2d-1)(log_p C + log_p d)+1. For k > d(Delta+1), N_k(f) = sum_i p^{k - ceil((k-nu_i)/e_i)} (Thm 19). N_k is constant iff D(f) != 0 (squarefree, every e_i=1). The O(d^2(log C+log d)) figure is the Sylvester envelope of k0, not a separate bound. This is a closed form for the global count, not a per-branch lift threshold. docs/theory/local_vs_global_stabilization.md.
